request.prompt: Dark fantasy horror battle score, bleak psychological action thriller instrumental music. A deadly encounter against monstrous predators in a night forest; desperate resistance and mortal danger. Pure instrumental music only, no vocals, speech, choir, screams, breathing sound effects, forest ambience, monster sounds, weapon sounds or environmental effects. Very low muted orchestral tom and taiko strokes lead in a slow heavy irregular pattern with long spaces between hits; continuous dark cello and double bass sustain, rubbing upper string clusters. Each drum stroke is weighty and muffled, a grim struggle against a much larger creature. No tribal celebration, festival rhythm, fast rolls, snare march, upbeat groove or percussion-only break.
